name: explorer
description: File-tree sidebar navigation reflecting the site's folder structure. Users expand/collapse directories; state persists in sessionStorage. Builds tree from window.__MDF_SEARCH__.pages data.

params.description: Enable file-tree navigation sidebar. Requires params.search.enable = true for page data.
params.effect: Renders collapsible file tree in sidebar. Loads caps/explorer/explorer.js and explorer.css.

dependencies.reason: Explorer builds its file tree from window.__MDF_SEARCH__.pages. Set params.search.enable = true.

css.note: Override --mdf-explorer-* CSS variables in sub-theme main.css to match brand colors

locked.reason: explorer.js uses .explorer class to find root and #explorer-content to mount the tree

partials.note: Keep .explorer root class and #explorer-content id. explorer.js depends on these.
